author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಣಕಣವ ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ವ ಚೀಮೆಯಂತಲೆ ಬದುಕು
ಹಣವಿದ್ಯೆ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿಡು ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಷಣದಿ ಗಳಿಸಿ
ಗುಣಿಸುವುದು ಹಂಚುತಿರೆ ಸದ್ವಿದ್ಯೆ ಧನಕನಕ 
ಗಣನೆಯಲೆ ಜೀವನವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Life is like the ant that carries off grain by grain;
guard your money and learning, earning moment by moment;
good learning and wealth multiply when shared;
life lies in the counting, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Like the ant, build patiently, bit by bit. Look after what you earn and learn, and remember that knowledge and wealth grow when they are shared.
